open_questions: No document gives the formula that turns an APY into one month's interest. The workflow assumes balance × APY ÷ 12 and derives actual_apy from the credited amount the same way; the documents do not confirm this.
The Bronze card bonuses are split across two documents (006: Platinum Rewards +0.55%, Diamond Elite +0.15%; 007: the other cards). The workflow assumes the two lists together are the full set.

The Gold Years Account needs the holder to be 62 or older to open it. No document says whether an existing Gold Years account held by someone under 62 still gives its Gold Plus boost. The workflow assumes any active checking account the customer holds counts, as doc 046 describes.
No relationship or tier bonus was found for the Bronze or Gold Plus savings accounts, so none is included.
